text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Just going off what I caught in a movie
really isn't enough; this is pretty tough."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, it was fantastic!
Thanks to you, I was able to do sparring practice very efficiently.
...I'd really like to thank you—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Well, if you have any juicy tips,
please do share!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*... *wheeze*...
...Ugh, somehow managed to swim all the way~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If Tran-chan hadn't been there,
I'd be at the bottom of the pool right now...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You're totally exaggerating~ I was only holding hands with you. And I let go every now and then halfway through, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well then, just as promised. Let me know once you find out what the pool makeup lesson is about~. Sounds like it'll be good intel.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...My thanks... to you.
Thanks to your help... I was able to transport it—right away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'm the one who should be thanking you.
New equipment makes for great material, after all."

Today is physical checkup day.
It's part of the race preparations, but—
choice_data_list: Huh, is your weight back to normal?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what do you mean, "when did you..."?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I pulled it off pretty smoothly~
by layering bluff upon bluff.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We can't let anyone get their hands on dirt about a weakness like weight gain, right?
